config.transform: perlang_z (L2-normalize then per-language z-score from own TRAIN text)
config.note: leakage fix is in the committed data: pooled + globally deduped + 80/10/10 re-split with 0 cross-split overlap; thresholds tuned on the validation split; mean+/-sd over seeds 0/1/2; models retrained fresh and saved to models_toxi/.
config.seed_note: the task-specified XGBoost config is seed-DETERMINISTIC (no row/col subsampling); to obtain a non-trivial mean+/-sd, each seed trains on a seed-dependent bootstrap resample (size=n_train, with replacement) of its train rows; val/test rows and every hyperparameter are unchanged.
